account: Something is being prepared in the town hall, but I have not learned its purpose. I have personally seen numerous lanterns in the hall and seen both builder and innkeeper put bread into the chest at (-50, -60, 30). Innkeeper was carrying a sack of bread. That looks like provisioning for a gathering rather than lighting work alone. Neighbour earlier described builder's work as ordinary supplies and hall lighting, and passed along an unconfirmed report from Townsfolk Two about lights at the bakery. Neighbour did not confirm any celebration when I visited for tea. Secretary has been trying to verify the arrangements, found builder absent from the workshop, and is now asking innkeeper about them. I tried asking builder directly, but he had gone before my words reached him; innkeeper heard my subsequent question, but I have not yet heard a reply. A communal meal or celebration seems plausible, though its occasion, timing, and organizers beyond the people making deliveries remain unknown. I feel out of the loop, but have no evidence that anyone is deliberately concealing it. Today's official business was otherwise quiet: no accounts were available and secretary reported no correspondence or visitors. My next scheduled appointment is home at nineteen o'clock.
